old_text:
Motorcyclist dies after hitting pothole on Western Highway in Victoria
In short:
A motorcyclist has died after hitting a pothole on the Western Highway in Victoria's south-west this afternoon.
The 71-year-old Ballarat man died at the scene.
What's next?
Victoria Police say the exact circumstances surrounding the crash are yet to be determined.
